description: Banner shows separate 'N new tickets', 'N tickets updated' and 'Refresh list' controls built from standard components
Toolbar focus notice shows 'Showing N new/updated tickets' (with a capped variant) and a 'Show all tickets' action
'Show all tickets' and 'Refresh list' drop focus and refetch the full list with its original filters; Refresh clears counts
refreshListForChanges uses the full list's filters rather than the focused request
Editing filters, board tab or search while focused leaves focus and applies the edit to the full list's filters
New and changed banner/notice strings exist in every tickets locale file and the xx/yy pseudo-locales are regenerated
